item.title: Basic Usage of nvidia-smi
item.description: 1. What Is nvidia-smi nvidia-smi stands for NVIDIA System Management Interface, the interface NVIDIA provides for managing and monitoring GPUs. nvidia-smi calls NVML. NVML stands for NVIDIA Management Library, a library that provides a set of C APIs for NVIDIA GPU monitoring and management. 1.1 Queryable State ECC error counts GPU utilization Active compute processes Clocks and PState Temperature and fan speed Power management Hardware identification 1.
